title: SS28 Women's Celebrity Influence
summary: Expect evening and festival dressing to carry SS28 influence: dark colour with flashes, sheer layers, lace.
research_period: SS28 previews published November 2025 to November 2026; SS27 runway record

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. SS28 fabric fairs open with Première Vision Paris on 26-28 January 2027, and the shows run from June to October 2027. This report projects from the first SS28 forecaster and fair previews, the SS27 runways and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it after the fairs and again after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Future Snoops' SS28 colour shift "After Dusk": "Deep aubergines, inky blues and murky greens are bringing a darker, more atmospheric mood to warm-weather dressing"<sup>[1]</sup>
- C2 Fashion Studio calls SS28 "Structured Clarity": consumers "are no longer asking for more. They're asking for better"<sup>[2]</sup>

sections.heading: What to take from it
sections.body:
- Dark looks with one bright accessory.
- Sheer over slip.
- Personal styling over head-to-toe brand.

design_implications: - Design pieces that style several ways.
commercial_implications: - Avoid real names and likenesses in marketing without agreements.

sources.title: After Dusk: why Spring/Summer 2028 is going dark
